Air Fryer Buffalo Cauliflower Bits
By: Laura (AKA Kraz...
Published: Monday, February 3, 2020 - 4:41am

Ingredients




1 Head of cauliflower
1/2 cup buffalo sauce (I used Frank brand)
2 TBS butter
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
Blue cheese dressing
6 stalks of celery – cleaned and sliced into sticks

Preparation

1 Cut cauliflower into small bite-sized pieces. 2 Preheat air fryer to 400° 3 Place the cauliflower pieces in the air fryer. 4 Cook for 6-7 minutes 5 Remove them from the air fryer and toss them in the sauce. 6 Return them to the air fryer and cook for another 6 minutes. 7 Serve with blue cheese dressing/dip and celery sticks 8 Sauce: 9 In a small stove-top pan, add buffalo sauce, butter, and garlic powder. 10 Cook until the butter melts.

About

Air Fryer Buffalo Cauliflower Bites are a super healthy way to get the bold flavors of buffalo sauce without the guilt.
